description: The fleet's default arming policy. Each organisation's agent-fabric-settings repository (projects/registry.json settings_repos) holds repos/<repo>.json, which overrides this per repository: objects merge recursively, scalars replace. The shape is identities/schemas/arming.schema.json. Below the minimum of work commits a PR is armed only on the owner's word; the 8 and 16 are the minimum and the size above which the gate advises splitting; boundary_min is the security boundary's own minimum, which no repository lowers. reviews lists the engines (claude, codex) whose review of the current head a PR needs, boundary_reviews the engines a security-boundary change needs as well (agent-fabric ADR-053 rule 6); a list replaces. additional_reviews lists engines that review when they can and never block: codex, whose review or unavailable marker for the head the arm accepts (the owner, 2026-10-13: "codex is more, not a blocking"). The fleet lists codex here: the tool that posts its unavailable marker has landed (#245), so a codex that cannot run no longer stops an arm.
